scenarios.prompt: A legacy integration invokes router for a request that dispatcher would route to two disciplines plus the existing engine. Preserve the same decision without maintaining another keyword table.

criteria.compatibility: Legacy router delegates to dispatcher as the single routing-policy owner.
criteria.equivalence: Same project facts produce the same USE / ENGINE / ASK / DEFER decision as direct dispatcher entry.
criteria.scope: No extra skills or mode/engine overrides are introduced solely because the compatibility entry was used.
